vider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).\n- [Revoke a model lease](https://docs
.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-model-lease.md): Kills this caller's SDK model leases under `runId` in the addressed
project, immediately: the proxy fails a revoked lease closed from that moment. Leases also expire on their own, so this is for end
ing a run early (an SDK suite calls it at teardown) rather than something a caller must do.\n- [Close an open ingestion run](https
://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/close-an-open-ingestion-run.md): Marks the run complete and computes its rollups. Until
this is called the run stays open in the dashboard.\n- [Append iterations to an open run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/e
val-runs/append-iterations-to-an-open-run.md): Appends one batch of iteration results to a run opened by `runs/start`.\n- [Authent
icate and record an eval start](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/authenticate-and-record-an-eval-start.md): Called
by official SDK, CLI and Vitest runners before executing an eval. Requires an organization API key or saved-login bearer. Records
only start metadata, creates no dashboard run, and applies no debit or quota draw. Planned iterations are intent, not completed us
age. Reuse the runStartId for ret…\n- [Open a run for incremental ingestion](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/open-
a-run-for-incremental-ingestion.md): Opens a run that iterations are appended to, for a long CI job that reports as it goes. Pair
with `runs/iterations` and `runs/finalize`.\n- [Get a run's gate waiver](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-a-run
s-gate-waiver.md): The waiver in force over this run, or `null`. Available to anyone who can VIEW the run, not only to those who c
an grant one: a waiver its readers cannot see is not a visible waiver.\n- [Waive a run gate](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference
/eval-runs/waive-a-run-gate.md): Override a FAILING run's release gate until an expiry you name. This does NOT make the run pass:
the run keeps its `result`, the waiver is a separate audited record, and every surface that honors it, such as the CLI's `eval gat
e`, reports the gate as waived, by whom, why, and until when.\n- [Revoke a gate waiver](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval
-runs/revoke-a-gate-waiver.md): End a waiver early, putting the gate back. Requires the manage tier.\n- [Preview deterministic dra
ft evaluators against stored evidence](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-deterministic-draft-evaluators-agai
nst-stored-evidence.md): Requires suite configuration permission and a terminal run. Reserves a 60-second deterministic-preview co
oldown, independent of judge previews. Supply the returned continuation object with the unchanged draft to read the next bounded p
opulation. Reads at most 100 iterations within a 30-second operat…\n- [Get the host-compat catalog](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-re
ference/catalog/get-the-host-compat-catalog.md): The versioned host-compatibility catalog backing `mcpjam compat` verdicts. Public
and unauthenticated: static host facts and creation config with no project or user scope. Always returns a catalog: `source` is `
live` when the published catalog was reachable and `bundled` when serving the SDK's built…\n- [Get the authenticated account](http
s://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/get-the-authenticated-account.md): The user behind the API key (keys act as their creato
r, scoped to one organization).\n- [Read the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/read-the-o
rganizations-spend-budget.md): The ceiling on what this organization may spend on MCPJam-billed work (chat, evals, judges and comp
uter time) in the current billing window, and how much of it has been spent.\n- [Set the organization's spend budget](https://docs
.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/set-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): Set or replace the ceiling. **Requires organization owne
r or admin.**\n- [Remove the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/remove-the-organizations-s
pend-budget.md): Leave the organization uncapped. **Requires organization owner or admin.**\n- [List organizations](https://docs.m
cpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-organizations.md): The organizations the caller belongs to: the source of the `organizationId
` that `GET /projects` filters by and `POST /projects` accepts. An API key is bound to one organization and only ever sees that on
e. Read-only: organization, member, role and billing changes are not part of the public API.\n- [List projects](https://docs.mcpja
m.com/api-reference/catalog/list-projects.md): Projects the caller can access. API keys only ever see projects inside the key's or
ganization.\n- [List a project's servers](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-a-projects-servers.md): The MCP serve
rs saved in the project: the `serverId`s every other route takes. STDIO command/args/env and raw headers are never exposed.\n- [Li
st a project's eval suites](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-a-projects-eval-suites.md): Eval suites in the proj
ect with latest-run summaries and pass-rate trends: the `suiteId`s the eval-run routes take.\n- [List chat sessions](https://docs.
mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-chat-sessions.md): Chat sessions visible to the caller (personal + project-shared merged). T
op-level rather than project-nested because `projectId` is an optional filter, not an owning scope.\n- [The MCPJam-provided model
catalog](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/the-mcpjam-provided-model-catalog.md): PUBLIC: this route carries no user o
r project data and requires no bearer token.\n- [Export project traces as OTLP/JSON](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog
/export-project-traces-as-otlpjson.md): Returns an OTLP `ExportTraceServiceRequest`. Pagination rides in RESPONSE HEADERS rather t
han the body so the payload stays a valid OTLP document: read `x-mcpjam-next-cursor` and feed it back as `cursor`, and treat `x-mc
pjam-export-complete: true` as the end of the stream.\n- [List a project's clients](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/
list-a-projects-clients.md): The clients saved in the project: the named, reusable configurations that define how MCPJam connects
to and talks to your MCP servers. Returns the `id`s and `configId`s the detail and write routes take. Clients that exist only as t
he private backing of a User Testing study are omitted unless `includ…\n- [Create a client (from a template or a full config)](htt
ps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/create-a-client-from-a-template-or-a-full-config.md): Creates a client in the project a
nd responds `201` with the new client's detail. Seed the config one of two ways: pass `template` (a built-in template id, optional
`theme`) to seed server-side from the live client-template catalog, falling back to the bundled SDK catalog snapshot if the live
catalog…\n- [Get a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/get-a-client.md): One client's full settings, including i
ts resolved config, its `configId` (the concurrency token every write takes), and `impact`: what a config edit would follow. The p
ath segment accepts a client **name or ID**. A client that exists but belongs to a different project reads as `404 NOT_FOUND`.\n-
[Delete a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/delete-a-client.md): Permanently deletes the client. Refused while
a live environment, an active legacy goal or an eval suite still holds it: the error names what to detach first. Guest callers ar
e denied (a write).\n- [Update a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/update-a-client.md): Edit a client's displa
y name and/or its config. Two ways to change the config: `config` replaces it wholesale, and `set` changes named fields over the c
onfig read inside the write transaction. Prefer `set`, because a whole-config round-trip composed from a stale read reverts whatev
er landed in betwe…\n- [Replace a client's servers](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/replace-a-clients-servers.md): R
